userStories.title: Shared task-dispatch normalization and presentation contract
userStories.description: As a node-room maintainer, I want one React-free normalizer mapping stored OMP batch and Claude single task-dispatch inputs to a canonical TaskSubtask[] model plus bounded task/generic presentation bodies, so that both renderers consume identical render-neutral data and malformed input degrades safely.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/task-normalize.ts exists exporting MAX_TASK_SUBTASKS=64, MAX_TASK_IDENTIFIER_CODE_UNITS=256, MAX_TASK_TOTAL_TEXT_CODE_UNITS=256*1024, MAX_TASK_EXCERPT_CODE_POINTS=160, TaskSubtask {name, agent: string|null, prompt}, NormalizedTaskDispatch {mode:'batch'|'single', context, subtasks}, normalizeTaskDispatch(), taskPromptExcerpt(); module is React-free and dependency-free

OMP {context?, tasks:[{name,agent,task}]} maps to mode 'batch' (context optional: absent/blank -> '', non-string -> null); Claude {description, prompt, subagent_type?} maps to mode 'single' with absent/blank subagent_type -> agent null; own 'tasks' key selects OMP even with Claude-like keys present and a malformed tasks value does not fall through to Claude

Whole-dispatch bounds: empty/non-array/over-64 tasks, identifier >256 code units, cumulative >262,144 UTF-16 code units (summed before trimming/allocating, walking at most 64 entries), missing/blank/wrong-type required fields, throwing getters, non-object/array/primitive input all return null with no throw, no truncation, no partial batch; fresh arrays/objects returned; same input twice yields deep-equal result

taskPromptExcerpt() collapses whitespace to one line, caps at 160 code points without splitting surrogate pairs, adds ellipsis only when content omitted, never scans beyond MAX_TASK_TOTAL_TEXT_CODE_UNITS

tool-presentation.ts gains GenericField, TaskSubtaskCard extends TaskSubtask {excerpt}, ToolBody union ({kind:'task',context,subtasks} | {kind:'generic',fields}), ToolPresentation.body: ToolBody|null and bodyFacts: string[], ToolRowPresentation.bodyBarText: string; all existing families and both safe fallback paths initialize body:null and bodyFacts:[]

Task branch calls normalizeTaskDispatch once and enriches subtasks via taskPromptExcerpt: batch -> task body + bodyFacts ['batch','N subtask(s)'] + count badge 'N subagent(s)'; single -> ['single dispatch'] + '1 subagent'; null -> generic body via bounded internally-caught genericBodyFields() (scan at most MAX_GENERIC_KEYS_SCANNED own keys, emit at most MAX_GENERIC_FACTS, bound keys/scalars, arrays '[n]', objects '{…}', never stringify, hostile enumeration -> []) with no subagent badge and no explicit task bar facts

toolRowPresentation() composes complete bodyBarText: normalized task -> bodyFacts first, skip redundant task count badge, append state/exit/output-state/duration text in existing order, prefix resolved family, join once; non-task rows preserve byte-for-byte badge mapping

Generic body attaches ONLY to malformed task-family input; every non-task family keeps body:null; MCP/safePresentation return body:null and empty bodyFacts; taskHeadline() field access contained inside task branch (malformed getter falls back to normal task headline while retaining generic body)

Tests written first and failing before implementation: task-normalize.test.ts covers the full phase-01 case table (OMP with/without context, Claude with/without/blank subagent_type, discriminator, missing fields, bad elements, empty/over-64 tasks, non-string context/subagent_type, primitives/arrays/null, throwing getters, exact/at-limit/one-over identifier and cumulative budgets, excerpt edge cases including emoji at cut, determinism) with the three canonical CAP-4 cases individually named; tool-presentation.test.ts covers body/badge/bodyFacts mapping, generic projection bounds/hostility, non-task body:null, and complete bodyBarText composition including 'task · single dispatch · <duration>' exactly once with no repeated subagent count
Commands pass: cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/task-normalize.test.ts && bun test src/lib/tool-presentation.test.ts src/lib/agent-history.test.ts && bun test src/lib/ && bun run type-check

No renderer, real provider, or agent-history.ts production change; _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/agent-node-room/sprint-status.yaml key 1-6-inspect-a-subagent-dispatch-and-its-subtasks moved backlog -> in-progress
userStories.technicalNotes: Implements phase-01-start.md verbatim. Contract in _bmad-output/specs/spec-agent-node-room/tool-presentation-contract.md; cases in test-plan.md CAP-4; architecture AD-1/2/3/8/10/14 in ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md. Existing constants MAX_GENERIC_KEYS_SCANNED/MAX_GENERIC_FACTS at tool-presentation.ts:15-16; ToolPresentation :60, ToolRowPresentation :79, toolPresentation() :522 (existing catch), toolRowPresentation() :538. Keep module dependency-free — tool-presentation imports it, importing back would cycle. Rejected by contract: dropped/unscanned fields, partial cards, truncated prompts, 'not shown' notices. No payload/prompt/tool-name logging.

userStories.title: Legacy and Console task/generic body renderers
userStories.description: As an operator, I want task tool rows on both Legacy NodeRoom and Console (both mounts) to render a markdown batch brief plus one collapsible card per subtask — and a bounded generic body for malformed input — so that I can see what was delegated and open the full prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Pre-edit integration check performed and recorded: whether Story 1.2 raw-payload-toggle has landed determines the body slot (readable body after body bar before temporary Input/Output disclosures vs readable body as the non-Raw branch); existing production code, not the sibling plan, is authoritative

Both renderers render presentation.bodyBarText verbatim — local recomposition from presentation.badges removed; task bars begin exactly 'task · batch · N subtask(s)' or 'task · single dispatch'; applicable runtime facts follow once; 'N subagents' never repeated in the bar; collapsed row still shows 'N subagent(s)' and normal runtime badges; non-task bars byte-for-byte preserved

Task context rendered only when body.context non-empty via existing ReactMarkdown + GFM/breaks/highlight/safe-URL stack; compact 11.5px mono text-secondary component overrides; no raw HTML; img override renders nothing; links keep safe external behavior; multi-block markdown may wrap, no arbitrary truncation

One native <details data-subtask-index="N"> per TaskSubtaskCard scoped inside its owning tool row (array index as row-local key, no global id); collapsed summary '▶ [agent ·] name — excerpt': chevron aria-hidden 9px column/10px type rotating 90deg in 120ms bound to the card's own open state (outer row open cannot rotate a closed card's chevron), motion-reduce removes transition; agent rendered only when non-null in node-approval 11.5px/600 with its separator (no orphan '·'); name bold; excerpt text-secondary consumed verbatim from card; summary >=24px, single line, min-w-0/overflow shrink rules; payload strings are React text, never title/id/aria-label attributes

Open card renders the complete prompt as a React text node in a mono pre-wrap word-breaking surface-inset box (long unbroken text cannot overflow horizontally); no per-subtask status/output/controls/provider name/fabricated label

Card container surface-elevated, 1px border, 6px radius, 6px vertical / 9px horizontal padding, 5px top margin; focus outline 2px accent-bright, offset -2px Legacy / +2px Console; existing tokens/classes only
Generic body renders projected fields only: key text-secondary, value text-primary, at most three rows, '{…}'/'[n]' literal markers never parsed; empty fields render no invented message

Outer row keeps controlled identity/touched state and the event.target !== event.currentTarget onToggle guard; subtask cards are native, initially closed, no React state; polling rerender of same tool identity retains card-open state; replacement tool identity starts with closed cards; nested toggles never mark/flip the outer row; existing full-output load/error/retry and Input/Output-or-Raw behavior unchanged

Console parity on both mounts (ConsoleNodeRoom selected room and ConsoleExecutionHistory inline); hiding tool calls hides task bodies; NO shared React component created (console-isolation.test.ts passes unchanged — no @/components/* or @/lib/api imports in experiments/console)

Tests written first and failing before implementation: NodeRoom.test.tsx static anatomy (OMP collapsed '2 subagents' + exact batch bar + context before two cards + agent/bold-name/excerpt anatomy + prompt in nested body not summary; Claude 'task · single dispatch' one card no context and no orphan separator with agent null; singular OMP wording; 64-card boundary batch fully rendered; malformed fixture -> generic rows, no cards/count badge/JSON dump; markdown emphasis/list rendered, no img/raw-HTML/executable link target; documented radius/padding/margin/font/focus/chevron/reduced-motion classes), LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx interaction (card click/Enter/Space toggles leave outer open+touched untouched, closed card chevron unrotated while outer open, focus retained after toggle, poll rerender retains open card, new identity resets, tab order outer summary -> Raw-if-present -> cards in input order -> Input/Output/full-output controls), ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx same matrix through selected room incl. hidden-tool-calls case, ConsoleExecutionHistory.test.tsx one OMP parity case with data-subtask-index scoped inside owning details[data-tool-id]

Commands pass: cd packages/web && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/NodeRoom.test.tsx src/components/workflows/LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/experiments/console/ && bun run test && bun run type-check && bun run lint; existing failed-row auto-open, non-task body-bar, and full-output tests stay green; no raw input parsing or provider branch exists in JSX
userStories.technicalNotes: Implements phase-02-two-surface-renderers.md. Consumes only presentation.body/bodyBarText — if a renderer needs item.input, local excerpt derivation, or bar-word composition, fix Phase 1 boundary first. NodeRoom.tsx ToolHistory :314, onToggle guard :367-374, badge render :419; ConsoleAgentHistoryList.tsx ToolHistory :238, onToggle :286-293, badges :328. userStories.title: Deterministic e2e fixture: fake-provider taskDispatch scenario, workflow, runtime helper
userStories.description: As a verifier, I want the env-gated e2e-fake provider to emit exact OMP and Claude task tool payloads under a strict scenario key, plus a seeded two-node workflow fixture and a runtime run method, so that Playwright can prove stored task dispatches end-to-end without credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: scenarioSchema in packages/providers/src/e2e-fake/provider.ts gains taskDispatch: z.enum(['omp','claude']).optional(); taskDispatch and emitTool are mutually exclusive — invalid combinations fail scenario validation instead of picking a branch

taskDispatch 'omp' emits exactly one tool call named 'Task' with synthetic input: markdown context containing emphasis, a list, a blocked image URL, and an unsafe-scheme link (for security assertions) plus two tasks with distinct names, agents, and multiline prompts; 'claude' emits exactly one tool call named 'Agent' with required description/prompt and NO subagent_type (exercises nullable agent path)

Each scenario emits the existing deterministic tool result/outcome sequence and stable exported fixture constants; no network, model call, delay, randomness in payload content, or real user data; existing emitTool/repetition/large-output/AskHuman/usage/default scenarios remain byte-for-byte compatible; provider still registered only under ARCHON_E2E_FAKE_PROVIDER=1; no real provider adapter touched

packages/providers/src/e2e-fake/provider.test.ts asserts exact emitted toolName, toolInput, call/result pairing, and mutual-exclusion validation failure — passes via cd packages/providers && bun test src/e2e-fake/provider.test.ts

e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-task-dispatch.yaml created: node 'omp-dispatch' runs e2e-fake with {"taskDispatch":"omp"}; node 'claude-dispatch' depends on it and runs with {"taskDispatch":"claude"}; both use the fake model, mutates_checkout: false, complete without an approval gate

e2e/lib/playwright/archon-runtime.ts copies this fixture into its isolated ARCHON_HOME, exports workflow/node name constants alongside the existing E2E_* constants, and provides runTaskDispatchWorkflow(): Promise<CliRunResult> reusing the existing CLI runner and owned-process cleanup — no new server, port strategy, or database seeder
cd e2e && npm run typecheck passes
userStories.technicalNotes: Implements the fixture half of phase-03-verification-and-closeout.md. scenarioSchema at provider.ts:45 (emitTool :47, env-gate comment :261, emitTool branch :320). archon-runtime.ts: constants :37-50, CliRunResult :64, run methods :114-120, createArchonRuntime :277. userStories.title: Full-stack Playwright proof, visual acceptance report, and closeout
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want automated Playwright evidence that both provider shapes render correctly on both surfaces at required widths, zoom, and accessibility states — plus the measured report and sprint/PR closeout — so that Story 1.6 ships verifiably and closes #179.
acceptanceCriteria: e2e/ui/task-dispatch-body.spec.ts created using the shared suite fixture and existing room-opening conventions, parameterized over 'console' and 'legacy'; one workflow run per surface may visit both nodes

Per surface behavior proof: register request observation before navigating to omp-dispatch; closed row is single-line containing 'Task' + '2 subagents'; keyboard-open -> body bar begins 'task · batch · 2 subtasks' with any runtime fact once after the prefix, context markdown precedes two row-scoped subtask cards, no element, unsafe link has no executable javascript: target, and the fixture image URL is never requested; Chromium accessibility evidence: each card summary is a collapsed disclosure named 'agent · subtask — excerpt' with decorative chevron excluded; DOM tab order verified including Raw before cards when Story 1.2 is present; Enter opens first card -> expanded state, complete multiline prompt, focus preserved, outer row still open; Space closes

claude-dispatch node: '1 subagent', body bar begins 'task · single dispatch' with no repeated count, exactly one card, no context block, readable summary without orphan agent separator; opening reveals the complete prompt

Computed-style assertions (not class strings) at 460px Legacy / 520px Console: card background resolves to --surface-elevated; 1px border, 6px radius, 6px/9px padding, 5px top margin; summary min-height >=24px and 11.5px font; agent weight 600 and color from --node-approval; name bold; excerpt --text-secondary; chevron 9px column/10px type/120ms transform and zero transition duration under reduced motion; prompt box resolves --surface-inset and wraps without horizontal overflow; focused summary has solid 2px --accent-bright outline with -2px Legacy / +2px Console offset

Contrast calculated from computed colors for agent/name/excerpt/prompt on both surfaces — every pair >= 4.5:1; attached via testInfo following agent-tool-row-visual.spec.ts conventions: legacy-task-body-460.png, console-task-body-520.png, legacy-claude-task-460.png, console-claude-task-520.png, task-card-contrast.json

Responsive states on both surfaces for the OMP row/card: reference room width in 1440x1000 viewport, 390x844 viewport via production responsive layout, 200% browser zoom via established CDP device-metrics approach; at each state summaries stay one line, opened prompt usable, no horizontal overflow attributable to the task body; no task-specific breakpoint invented

plans/260918-0825-issue-179-subagent-dispatch-subtasks/reports/visual-acceptance.md written AFTER measurement: command/commit, artifact names, mapping/content results, geometry table, contrast table, focus/keyboard/AX findings, reduced-motion result, request-observation result, responsive/zoom results; captures compared against task sections in key-transcript-states.html and full-transcript-review.html plus collapsed task rows in both surface mockups — every visible delta recorded with its authority-based disposition; only synthetic fixture text used

All gates green on the final diff: cd packages/providers && bun test src/e2e-fake/provider.test.ts; cd packages/web && bun run test && bun run type-check; bun run build:web; cd e2e && npm run typecheck && ARCHON_E2E_PROOF=1 npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts ui/task-dispatch-body.spec.ts with no skips; bun run validate (root bun test never run; e2e package npm ci/browser setup done first if uninstalled)

Nine-perspective final audit confirmed (product outcome, architecture/provider-free JSX, contracts, security/reliability/data integrity, performance bounds, completeness incl. both Console mounts, testing coverage, ops/rollback, maintainability); sprint-status.yaml key 1-6-inspect-a-subagent-dispatch-and-its-subtasks set to done only now; PR uses repository template with required sections, exact validation commands/artifacts, 'Closes #179', targeting the verified current integration branch
userStories.technicalNotes: Implements the proof half of phase-03-verification-and-closeout.md. Credential-dependent or static-HTML fallbacks are NOT evidence — the fake-provider path is the deterministic seam. Closed <details> children are already mounted in the DOM. If a visual assertion exposes a production defect, fix BOTH renderer copies, strengthen the Phase 2 component assertion, rebuild, rerun Playwright. Never weaken geometry/contrast/overflow checks for a nicer screenshot. If Story 1.2/1.3 merged meanwhile, re-run their focused suites and verify one readable-vs-Raw tree remains. Runtime fixture already owns PIDs/ports/temp homes/cleanup — no extra dev server or operator DB.
